title: oenothera fruticetorum
intro: Oenothera fruticetorum, commonly known as the shrubby evening primrose, is a plant species in the family Onagraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Oenothera fruticetorum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain and inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
